cases.name: etaf-translate-rich-inline-preserves-links-code-and-malformed-fallback
cases.purpose: Rich paragraphs preserve inline code atoms, forward translated link presses to the original Host, and survive malformed tags without dropping text.

cases.name: etaf-translate-exclusions-and-scope-control
cases.purpose: Content scope skips :translate no, code blocks, UI controls and target-language text, while full scope translates constrained chrome safely in place.

cases.name: etaf-translate-instant-mode-style-cycling-uses-cache
cases.purpose: Switching styles and cycling bilingual-stacked, replace and off reuses L1 cache without extra engine requests.

cases.name: etaf-translate-survives-live-reactive-commits-incrementally
cases.purpose: Application commits incrementally translate only newly added or edited paragraphs and dispose companions for removed items cleanly.

cases.name: etaf-translate-async-cancellation-and-error-retry
cases.purpose: Disabling cancels in-flight async requests and ignores late replies, while failed units expose an isolated retry action.

cases.name: etaf-translate-rules-l2-cache-and-provider-extensibility
cases.purpose: Declarative auto-translate rules, pluggable L2 cache persistence and virtualized content providers integrate through public APIs.

cases.name: etaf-translate-real-markdown-document-with-table-and-code
cases.purpose: End-to-end translation of an etaf-ui-markdown document translates headings, prose, quotes and table cells while skipping fenced code blocks.

cases.name: etaf-translate-overflow-scroll-viewport-lazy-promotion
cases.purpose: Inside an :overflow scroll container, far off-screen paragraphs stay deferred without loading placeholders and promote automatically when scrolled into view.

cases.name: etaf-translate-streaming-incremental-delivery-and-partial-retry
cases.purpose: Streaming :on-unit-done renders completed paragraphs immediately while still in flight, and async partial failures auto-retry only undelivered units solo.

cases.name: etaf-translate-skips-technical-lists-and-suppresses-identical-companions
cases.purpose: Comma-separated package/identifier lists are skipped before dispatch, and translations identical to source text clear loading without rendering duplicate bilingual bars.

cases.name: etaf-translate-sqlite-l2-cache-and-persisted-site-rules
cases.purpose: Native SQLite L2 cache serves fresh L1 instances with zero extra engine calls, and remembered site rules and glossary terms persist cleanly across disk reloads.

cases.name: etaf-translate-profiles-context-and-fallback-engine
cases.purpose: Named engine profiles forward document title context and prompt style, and automatically cascade failed units to the configured fallback engine.

cases.name: etaf-translate-minimal-panel-pure-popup-and-3-styles
cases.purpose: Enforces the 5-command interactive surface, 3 editorial bilingual styles, slim reactive control panel, and pure-translation quick popup without repeating original text.

cases.name: etaf-translate-latex-math-protection-and-paragraph-toggle
cases.purpose: Inline and display LaTeX math expressions are protected as atomic placeholders without misclassifying currency, and etaf-translate-paragraph toggles a single paragraph on and off.

cases.name: etaf-translate-etaf-reader-provider-and-page-switch
cases.purpose: Built-in etaf-reader provider merges fixed 1-line visual slots into logical paragraphs, attaches unclipped companions, and updates cleanly across page turns.

cases.name: etaf-translate-maillist-logical-paragraphs
cases.purpose: Built-in maillist provider joins 72-column wrapped prose and quote lines into logical paragraphs, strips repeated quote prefixes, skips sidebars/diffs/signatures, and switches cleanly between bilingual and replace modes.
